text_block_list.text: The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring).

Even on the grand stage, Mayano Top Gun 
showed no signs of nerves, heading toward 
the race happily as always.

After she headed off to the race, the 
Trainer—

She learned that after finishing this 
race, Narita Brian would enter an extended 
adjustment period in preparation for the 
"Arima Kinen".
